eras.label: The appointed electoral college
eras.blurb: Half the Federal National Council is elected, and even that half is chosen not by ordinary citizens but by an electoral college the rulers of each emirate handpick. Political parties are banned, so every one of these five contests returned twenty independents to twenty seats, and the only line that moves from election to election is the college itself: 6,595 members in 2006, expanded to 398,879 by 2023.

elections.summary: Independents finished first with 20 of 40 seats. Turnout 74.4%.
elections.caveat: The 20 elected seats are chosen not by citizens at large but by an electoral college the rulers of each emirate select, and the other 20 seats in the council are simply appointed by those same rulers.
